title: Panda wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- panda body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='26' ry='18' fill='#c7d4e8'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='76' rx='8' ry='11' fill='#5b4a8a'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='76' rx='8' ry='11' fill='#5b4a8a'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='92' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#5b4a8a'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='92' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#5b4a8a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='45' r='24' fill='#dbe6f5'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='26' r='8' fill='#5b4a8a'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='26' r='8' fill='#5b4a8a'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='26' r='4' fill='#8a76c9'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='26' r='4' fill='#8a76c9'/>
  <!-- eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx='39' cy='44' rx='9' ry='11' fill='#4a3a7a' transform='rotate(-15 39 44)'/>
  <ellipse cx='61' cy='44' rx='9' ry='11' fill='#4a3a7a' transform='rotate(15 61 44)'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='39' cy='45' r='4' fill='#f5f9ff'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='45' r='4' fill='#f5f9ff'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='44' r='2' fill='#2a1f4a'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='44' r='2' fill='#2a1f4a'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#4a3a7a'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 58 Q50 63 56 58' fill='none' stroke='#6a5aa0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='55' r='3' fill='#f0a0c0'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='55' r='3' fill='#f0a0c0'/>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <path d='M38 24 L50 2 L62 24 Z' fill='#ff5fa2'/>
  <path d='M42 18 L50 4 L58 18 Z' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='4' r='3.5' fill='#4ad6ff'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='14' r='2' fill='#4ad6ff'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='14' r='2' fill='#4ad6ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='20' r='2' fill='#7cff6b'/>
  <!-- hat brim -->
  <rect x='37' y='22' width='26' height='4' rx='2' fill='#4ad6ff'/>
</svg>
